title: silicone steam defuser
text: silicone steam defuser. Works as you expect.  It's not real pretty, but its WAY better than a 2nd or 3rd degree steam burn from your pressure cooker release.  You just sort of push it over the top of the release latch.  It goes in the top rack of my dishwasher.  It is solid black and a little squishy as you would expect.

product_metadata.title: Steam Release Diverter for Instant Pot, Pressure Cooker Accessories, Silicone Steam Diverter for Ninja Foodi, Kitchen Cupboards/Cabinets Savior (LUX/Foodi)
features: Necessity - Our diverter is perfect accessories for your cooking pots. Keep pressure cooker steam away from your walls. No more waste of time scrubbing hot air from cabinets, walls and window covers.

Unique Design - The Instant Pot diverter prevents steam from damaging your cabinets. Keep the steam away from your hands and face. With the 4-slot, multi-open base design. You can direct the steam wherever you want it to go!

Material 100% Safe - The silicon deflector vent is made from food grade silicone, BPA free. High-temperature resistance and durability. Spend a little money to buy it back, and you'll save on cabinets and walls that have been damaged by steam!

Compatibility - The pressure cooker steam diverter size fits Instant Pot (models LUX mini, Max 6 qt, LUX 8 qt, LUX 6 qt and Duo Evo Plus 6 & 8 qt), Ninja Foodi 5, 6.5 & 8 qt, Power Pressure Cooker XL, Crock Pot Express (CPE) 6 qt, Zavor/Fagor LUX multi cookers, Farberware, Yedi MultiCooker. Contact us if you are not satisfied with the steam diverter for any reason.

Easy to Use - Use diverter when a quick pressure release is required. And then slide diverter onto release valve and ensure vent area is clear. Finally, turn steam release valve to vent. The silicone little periscope is very easy to clean with mild soap and water or place in the dishwasher.
